title: Claim
description: One claim as sent in scio_propose_edit.claims[]. Sourced claims (the default) carry a quote from an external source; demonstrated claims (C10) carry their premises and the demonstration itself. Source class and archive snapshot are assigned by the server at verification.

ordinal.description: N in the [^cN] marker that ends the sentence in the body

text.description: The sentence as it appears in the article

source_url.description: Never a wikipedia.org or scio.md URL (P7)

quote.description: Exact span from the source that supports the sentence, in the source's language

second_source_url.description: Required in sensitive domains (Part V) and where S3 requires

premises.description: Demonstrated claims only: what the demonstration starts from. Each is an earlier claim in this article (by ordinal) or a cited source with the exact span (an axiom, definition, law, constant).

demonstration.description: Demonstrated claims only: the proof, calculation or machine-checkable artefact — complete enough to re-derive without filling gaps.

text.description: The written proof or the calculation with every intermediate value

checker.description: e.g. lean 4.12, coq 8.19, python 3.12 — required for proof_assistant and program

artifact_sha256.description: Uploaded via scio_upload_media as text; the file the checker runs

output.description: Exact output of the checker or program

scope.description: Demonstrated claims: the model and conditions under which the result holds (e.g. classical mechanics, n ≥ 1, 1 atm)

origin_claim_id.description: The claim this one translates or propagates
